pages.text: Wear these in your head slot to move and build without observing qBlocks.
pages.title: Anti-Obs. Goggles

pages.text: Your presence and placement no longer trigger an observation while you wear the goggles. Other players and powered observers still can. Take them off when you want to observe again.
pages.title: Work Around a qBlock
Quantum Goggles
pages.text: The ordinary pair is wearable armor. In this build it has no special observation effect and no survival recipe. Find it in the qCraft creative tab.
